tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rdo rje gling pa'i gter byon rtsa gsum spyi'i skong bsdus bzhugs so// 1$0000300hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral gnas lugs mngon gyur pa'i: rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang: ting 'dzin mchog brnyes brda yi brgyud pa ste: rig 'dzin rig pa brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang: bka' lung lhag chad med pa'i gang zag mchog: snyan khungs brgyud pa'i bla ma'i thugs= bka' brgyud gter du sbed pa'i bya ra mdzad: mkha' 'gro gtad rgya brgyud pa'i thugs= ma 'ongs las 'phro can la lung ston pa'i: smon lam dbang bskur brgyud pa'i thugs= shes bya thams cad rnam pa kun mkhyen pa'i: dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs= 'gro kun zhi bde'i ngang la 'dren mdzad pa'i: gsung mchog dam chos rnams kyi thugs= sa dang lam la gnas nas zhing mchog skyong: 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi thugs= lta sgom mkhyen pa mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i: skyes mchog bla ma rnams kyi thugs= dngos grub thogs pa med par ster mdzad pa'i: yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs= phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun sel ba'i: mkha' 'gro dam can rnams kyi thugs= ma skyes rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa ste: rang bzhin spros bral chos sku'i thugs= dug lnga ye shes lnga yi ngo bor smin: zhi ba longs spyod rdzogs sku'i thugs= rang snang ma 'gags gzhan snang der ston pa'i: sprul sku 'gro don mdzad pa'i thugs= zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba'i thugs= khrag 'thung rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: lnga bcu rtsa brgyad khro bo'i thugs= sku mchog 'gyur ba med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thugs= gsung mchog 'gag pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: padma gsung gi lha tshogs thugs= thugs mchog g.yo ba med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs thugs= yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:

bdud rtsi yon tan lha tshogs thugs= phrin las drag po sgrol byed dkyil 'khor nas: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs thugs= sha khrag rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rbod gtong ma mo'i lha tshogs thugs= thugs rje'i gdung gsob sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin bla ma'i lha tshogs thugs= dam rdzas rdza ltar lhag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs= dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs thugs= dpal gyi spyan sngar rang rtags srog snying phul: dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi thugs= sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i: mthu chen dpal mgon lcam dral thugs= sngags kyi rgyud sde bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: sngags bdag sngags srung rnams kyi thugs= slob dpon chen pos bka' yi gnyer du gtad: gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs= tshul bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i sdongs grogs mdzad: gzhi bdag gzhi srung rnams kyi thugs= 'jig rten khams 'dir mthu dang ldan pa'i bdag: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum bcu'i thugs= zlog pas mi bzlog sngags zlog mkhan gyi gshed: dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i thugs= stong khams 'di na drag rtsal gzer gyi bdag: gza' bdud chen po dpal 'bar thugs= mthu nus thogs med dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed: srung ma e ka dzā ṭi'i thugs= a ti bla med bka' yi bya ra mdzad: bshan pa srog sgrub nag mo'i thugs= dam la gnas shing gnod byed sgrol mdzad pa'i: gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar nag thugs= sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i: dam can rdo rje legs pa'i thugs= longs spyod rin chen gter la mnga' brnyes pa'i: nor bdag gnod sbyin rnams kyi thugs= las kyi mtha' sdud 'jam dpal thugs kyi sras: srung ma nā ga raksha'i thugs= lha khang gtsug lag skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i: rgyal po li byin hā ra'i thugs= srid pa bod kyi srog bdag chen po ni:

bdud po yab rje nag po'i thugs= gtor len rnal 'byor skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis thugs= bskang ngo bskal pa'i bar du thugs dam bskang: bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis bskang: sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sbyor: sgrol ba med de khams gsum yongs kyis sgrol: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi dang: khyad par rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang: 'bru bcud stong la sbyar pa'i dza gad dang: padma māṃ sa bcas pa'i rakta dang: dzap dang gar 'cham ging dang stangs stabs dang: snang gsal 'od kyi zhun mar gsal ba dang: stong gsal dbyer med lta sgom mthar thug dang: tshogs kyi longs spyod rgya chen 'di dag gis: skyes mchog bla ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs= las byed mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs= gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs= gzhi bdag gzhi srung rnams kyi thugs= mchod yul gong ma rnams kyi thugs= sbyin yul 'og ma rnams kyi thugs= rigs drug pha ma rnams kyi thugs= lan chags mgron gyur rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: thams cad thugs dam gnyan po des bskangs la: g.yar dam sor chud dngos grub bstsal du gsol:
sprul sku rdo rje gling pas gter nas spyan drangs pa'o// bkra shis so/// /
